newsitem.title: USA: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: CSCE world sugar called to open little changed.

text.p: CSCE world sugar was called to open mostly unchanged on Friday, dealers said.
But prices could work lower during the day with the benchmark October contract testing support at 11.05-11.00 cents, they added.
Thursday, the benchmark October contract settled 0.14 cent weaker at 11.16 cents per lb, having ranged from 11.31 to 11.15 cents. Second-position March ended 0.12 cent lower at 11.35 cents.
An estimated 14,510 lots changed hands on the day.
LIFFE white sugar futures stood slightly lower on Friday in light volume. At 0843 EDT/1243 GMT, LIFFE October was trading down $1.20 at $319.80, while the rest of the board was $0.20 to $1.60 weaker.
